purpose: Static field mapping; input intentionally absent; no production-ready invocation claimed

schema.description: URL of the input image to convert to 3D
schema.title: Image Url

schema.description: Output resolution; higher is slower but more detailed
schema.title: Resolution

schema.description: How closely the initial 3D structure follows the input image. Higher values produce more faithful but potentially noisier results.
schema.title: Ss Guidance Strength

schema.description: Dampens artifacts from high guidance in stage 1. Lower values allow stronger guidance effects, higher values stabilize the output.
schema.title: Ss Guidance Rescale

schema.description: Number of denoising steps for the initial structure. More steps = slower but potentially higher quality.
schema.title: Ss Sampling Steps

schema.description: Controls noise schedule sharpness for structure generation. Higher values produce sharper transitions.
schema.title: Ss Rescale T

schema.description: How closely the detailed geometry follows the input image. Higher values add more detail but may introduce noise.
schema.title: Shape Slat Guidance Strength

schema.description: Dampens artifacts from high guidance in the shape stage. Increase if you see noisy geometry.
schema.title: Shape Slat Guidance Rescale

schema.description: Number of denoising steps for shape refinement. More steps = slower but potentially smoother geometry.
schema.title: Shape Slat Sampling Steps

schema.description: Controls noise schedule sharpness for shape refinement. Higher values produce sharper geometric details.
schema.title: Shape Slat Rescale T

schema.description: How closely the texture follows the input image colors. Higher values produce more vivid but potentially oversaturated textures.
schema.title: Tex Slat Guidance Strength

schema.description: Dampens artifacts from high guidance in the texture stage. Increase if textures look noisy or have color banding.
schema.title: Tex Slat Guidance Rescale

schema.description: Number of denoising steps for texture generation. More steps = slower but potentially cleaner textures.
schema.title: Tex Slat Sampling Steps

schema.description: Controls noise schedule sharpness for texture generation. Higher values produce sharper texture details.
schema.title: Tex Slat Rescale T

schema.description: Target number of vertices in the final mesh. Lower values produce smaller files but less detail. 500k is good for most uses, reduce to 20k-50k for web/mobile.
schema.title: Decimation Target

schema.description: Resolution of the texture image baked onto the mesh. Higher values capture finer surface details but produce larger files.
schema.title: Texture Size
